title.en: China says solar power capacity surpasses coal for first time
title.zh: 中国太阳能发电装机容量首次超过煤电

summary.en: China's National Energy Administration announced that the country's installed solar power capacity has exceeded that of coal-fired power for the first time as of the end of July this year. This milestone comes as China, the world's largest greenhouse gas emitter, has pledged to peak carbon emissions by 2030 and...
summary.zh: 中国国家能源局周二宣布，截至今年7月底，中国太阳能发电装机容量已首次超过煤电装机容量。中国是世界上最大的温室气体排放国，已承诺在2030年前达到碳排放峰值，并在2060年前实现碳中和。

body.en: China’s installed solar energy capacity has surpassed that of coal-fired power for the first time, the national energy body said Tuesday, hailing the milestone. Installation of solar photovoltaic panels on the roofs of the Hongqiao Passenger Rail Terminal in Shanghai, China, in 2010. Photo: Climate Group, via Flickr. China, the world’s largest emitter of greenhouse gases that drive climate change, has pledged to peak carbon emissions by 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060. “As of the end of July this year, China’s installed solar power capacity reached 1.286 billion kilowatts,” the National Energy Administration (NEA) said. “For the first time, photovoltaic installed capacity surpassed coal-fired power, becoming the largest power source category in China,” it added. The country’s coal-fired power installed capacity, the energy body said, stood at 1.285 billion kilowatts. Solar generation rose 15.5 percent on-year in the first seven months of 2026 to 802.4 billion kilowatt-hours, about one-eighth of the country’s total, the NEA said in another statement. It did not detail in these statements what the total generation of coal-powered energy was for the first seven months of this year. Lamma power station. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. The NEA said China’s installed solar power capacity and power generation “have maintained a steady trend of rapid growth”, with it playing an “increasingly prominent role” in guaranteeing electricity supply and driving the energy transition. Coal has been China’s key power generation source for decades and a key driver of its planet-warming emissions. But the country’s coal-fired power generation fell by nearly two percent in 2025, despite rising energy demand in the world’s largest emitter, data reviewed by AFP showed in February. It marked the first decline in six years, with some analysts saying it was the first time on record that coal generation dropped at the same time as power demand rose. China has seen an explosive growth in its renewable installation, with coal’s share in its energy mix edging down in recent years. The country installed a record 315 gigawatts of solar power and 119 gigawatts of wind power capacity last year — over 80 percent of total newly installed power generation capacity, according to the China Electricity Council.
body.zh: 国家能源机构周二表示，中国太阳能装机容量首次超过燃煤发电，并赞扬这一里程碑。 2010 年，中国上海虹桥客运码头屋顶安装太阳能光伏板。照片：气候组织，来自 Flickr。中国是全球最大的温室气体排放国，导致气候变化，并承诺到2030年实现碳排放峰值，到2060年实现碳中和。国家能源局表示，“截至今年7月底，中国太阳能发电装机容量达到12.86亿千瓦”。报告补充称：“光伏装机容量首次超过煤电，成为中国第一大电源类别。”该能源机构称，中国煤电装机容量为12.85亿千瓦。国家能源局在另一份声明中表示，2026 年前 7 个月太阳能发电量同比增长 15.5%，达到 8024 亿千瓦时，约占全国发电总量的八分之一。该公司在这些声明中没有详细说明今年前七个月的煤电发电总量是多少。南丫岛发电厂。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。国家能源局表示，中国太阳能发电装机容量和发电量“保持平稳较快增长态势”，在保障电力供应、推动能源转型方面“作用日益凸显”。几十年来，煤炭一直是中国的主要发电来源，也是导致地球变暖的排放的主要驱动因素。但法新社 2 月份查阅的数据显示，尽管全球最大排放国的能源需求不断上升，但该国的燃煤发电量到 2025 年仍下降了近 2%。这标志着六年来的首次下降，一些分析师表示，这是有记录以来首次煤炭发电量在电力需求上升的同时下降。中国的可再生能源装机量呈爆炸性增长，但近年来煤炭在能源结构中的份额逐渐下降。中国电力企业联合会的数据显示，去年中国太阳能发电装机容量达到创纪录的315吉瓦，风电装机容量达到119吉瓦，占新增发电装机容量的80%以上。

reflection.en: The news that China's solar power capacity has now surpassed its coal capacity marks a significant shift in energy production. This development underscores humanity's role in stewarding the planet's resources, reminding us that all the earth and everything in it belongs to the Creator. May this transition inspire further responsible care for creation.
reflection.zh: 中国太阳能发电装机容量现已超过煤电的消息标志着能源生产的一个重要转变。这一发展凸显了人类在管理地球资源方面的作用，提醒我们，地和其中万物都属于造物主。愿这一转变能激励我们进一步负责任地爱护受造界。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Hong Kong Int’l School and US church founder reach settlement over financial mismanagement lawsuit
title.zh: 香港国际学校与其美国教会创始人就财务管理不善诉讼达成和解

summary.en: Hong Kong International School (HKIS) and its US-based founder, The Lutheran Church—Missouri Synod (LCMS), have reached an out-of-court settlement. The founder had sued the school over alleged financial mismanagement and accusations that it served only an 'elite' segment of the city's population. While the school will...
summary.zh: 香港国际学校（HKIS）及其美国母会——路德教会密苏里教区（LCMS）已达成庭外和解。该母会此前因涉嫌财务管理不善以及指控学校仅服务于本市“精英”阶层而起诉了该学校。虽然学校将不再由LCMS管理，但将继续提供“植根于基督教信仰的美国式教育”。

body.en: Hong Kong International School (HKIS) and its US-based founder have reached an out-of-court settlement, after the latter sued the school last year for alleged financial mismanagement and over accusations it served only an “elite” section of the city’s population. Hong Kong International School’s Lower Primary campus in Repulse Bay. Photo: HKIS. The school will no longer be governed by its founder, The Lutheran Church—Missouri Synod (LCMS), but will continue to provide an “American-style education grounded in the Christian faith,” a letter sent to parents on Tuesday read. HKIS board of managers chairperson Harold Kim, who wrote the letter, said the school remained in a strong financial position and the settlement would not affect tuition fees. The latest development brings to a close a lawsuit filed by the LCMS at the High Court in September last year. While the major US church body originally entered Hong Kong in 1949 to provide services for the local community, in particular mainland Chinese refugees, it later expanded its role and founded HKIS in 1966 to target expatriate families. Today, HKIS has two campuses, one in Repulse Bay and another in Tai Tam, and is known for providing an American-style curriculum. The High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. LCMS sued Hong Kong International School Association Limited (HKISAL) – the school’s operator – over “serious concerns” regarding its finances and what the church deemed to be transparency and leadership issues. HKIS holds more than HK$2.8 billion in financial reserves and serves “only a small, elite section of Hong Kong,” going against the school’s original mission of being open to “all children,” the LCMS said then. ‘Uncertainty and anxiety’ In the email to parents on Tuesday, Harold Kim said the school acknowledged the LCMS’s role in the founding of HKIS, as well as its contribution to establishing the Christian identity that continues to shape HKIS. “The past 11 months have brought uncertainty and anxiety to our community, and we are grateful for the support of and trust in HKIS that you have shown throughout this period,” Kim wrote. In an FAQ for parents, the school stated that the lease for the Repulse Bay campus was still in the LCMS’s name, but that procedures were underway for the lease to be transferred to HKISAL. Hong Kong International School’s Tai Tam campus. Photo: Cyril Ha/Google Maps. When the LCMS filed the lawsuit, there was concern that the school could potentially be evicted from its Repulse Bay campus . The Tai Tam campus lease is held by HKISAL. The LCMS will also no longer pursue the establishment of Hong Kong Pacific School. The body had said earlier that it would...
body.zh: 香港国际学校 (HKIS) 与其美国创始人去年达成庭外和解，后者去年起诉该学校涉嫌财务管理不善，并指控该学校只为香港的“精英”群体服务。香港国际学校小学低年级校园位于浅水湾。照片：香港测量师学会。周二发给家长的一封信中写道，学校将不再由其创始人密苏里路德教会 (LCMS) 管理，但将继续提供“以基督教信仰为基础的美式教育”。写这封信的香港国际学校管理委员会主席哈罗德·金表示，学校的财务状况仍然强劲，和解不会影响学费。最新进展结束了 LCMS 去年 9 月向高等法院提起的诉讼。虽然美国主要教会团体最初于 1949 年进入香港，为当地社区，特别是中国大陆难民提供服务，但后来扩大了其作用，并于 1966 年成立了 HKIS，以服务外籍家庭为目标。如今，香港国际学校拥有两个校区，一处位于浅水湾，另一处位于大潭，并以提供美式课程而闻名。高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 LCMS 起诉学校的运营商香港国际学校协会有限公司 (HKISAL)，理由是对其财务状况以及教会认为的透明度和领导力问题表示“严重关切”。 LCMS 当时表示，HKIS 拥有超过 28 亿港元的财务储备，并且只为“香港的一小部分精英阶层”提供服务，这违背了学校向“所有儿童”开放的最初使命。 “不确定性和焦虑” 在周二发给家长的电子邮件中，Harold Kim 表示，学校承认 LCMS 在 HKIS 创立过程中所发挥的作用，以及它对建立继续塑造 HKIS 的基督教身份的贡献。 Kim 写道：“过去 11 个月给我们的社区带来了不确定性和焦虑，我们感谢你们在此期间对 HKIS 的支持和信任。”学校在给家长的常见问题解答中表示，浅水湾校区的租约仍在 LCMS 名下，但正在办理将租约转让给 HKISAL 的程序。香港国际学校大潭校区。照片：Cyril Ha/谷歌地图。当 LCMS 提起诉讼时，有人担心学校可能会被逐出浅水湾校区。大潭校园的租约由HKISAL持有。 LCMS也将不再寻求设立香港太平洋学校。该机构早些时候曾表示，它会...

reflection.en: This settlement highlights the tension between institutional mission and accusations of exclusivity or mismanagement. The call to 'act justly and to love mercy' is a timeless reminder for any organization, especially one grounded in faith, to maintain transparency and serve its community equitably. True Christian education should reflect these principles in...
reflection.zh: 此次和解凸显了机构使命与排他性或管理不善指控之间的紧张关系。“秉公行义，喜爱怜悯”的呼吁，是任何组织，尤其是植根于信仰的组织，保持透明度和公平服务社区的永恒提醒。真正的基督教教育应在其治理和外展中体现这些原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: T1 to be in force at least through Wednesday morning
title.zh: 一号戒备信号至少在周三早上生效

summary.en: The Hong Kong Observatory stated that the Standby Signal No. 1 would remain in effect through Wednesday morning. Tropical Cyclone Saudel was located over 200 kilometers southeast of the city on Tuesday afternoon and is forecast to move closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong, potentially intensifying. The cyclone is...
summary.zh: 香港天文台表示，一号戒备信号将至少在周三早上生效。热带气旋“沙德尔”于周二下午位于香港东南偏东方二百多公里处，并预测将逐渐靠近广东东部沿岸并增强。该气旋预计将为香港带来狂风骤雨，离岸及高地风势间中会增强。

body.en: The observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 would remain in force for the rest of the day and Wednesday morning, but the chances of a No. 3 signal are not high. The standby signal is in effect as Tropical Cyclone Saudel was skirting at over 200 kilometres to the southeast of Hong Kong on Tuesday afternoon, and was forecast to edge closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong and intensify gradually. The forecaster said Saudel would bring squally showers to the city, and local winds would become occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. “Unless Saudel intensifies significantly and its associated strong winds are closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary, the chance of strong winds generally over Hong Kong is not high,” the observatory said. Forecasters added that Saudel will linger in the northeastern part of the South China Sea and the coast of eastern Guangdong on Thursday, and there are still uncertainties in its movement and intensity, so a tropical cyclone warning signal may remain in force until later this week. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 天文台表示，一号待命信号将在当天余下时间及周三上午继续生效，但出现三号待命信号的可能性并不高。热带气旋“沙德尔”周二下午在香港东南方200多公里处盘旋，预计将逼近粤东海岸并逐渐增强，备用信号生效。预报员称，萨德尔将为该市带来狂风阵雨，近海和高地局部风力偶尔会增强。天文台表示：“除非‘沙德尔’显着增强，且与之相关的强风更靠近珠江口附近，否则香港普遍出现强风的机会并不高。”预报员补充说，“沙德尔”将于周四在南海东北部和粤东沿海徘徊，其移动和强度仍存在不确定性，因此热带气旋警告信号可能会持续到本周晚些时候。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: As Tropical Cyclone Saudel approaches Hong Kong, the Standby Signal No. 1 is in effect, reminding residents of nature's power. In times of potential storm and uncertainty, Psalm 46:1 offers a profound assurance: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This ancient truth can anchor our hearts amidst the winds and rain, reminding us...
reflection.zh: 随着热带气旋“沙德尔”逼近香港，一号戒备信号生效，提醒居民大自然的力量。在潜在的风暴和不确定时期，诗篇46:1 提供了深刻的保证：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这古老的真理可以在风雨中稳固我们的心，提醒我们，即使在元素肆虐时，神圣的临在也提供坚定的保护。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Salt of the Earth: How Egypt's coastal sabkhas tell a story of climate and change
title.zh: 大地之盐：埃及沿海的盐沼如何讲述气候与变迁的故事

summary.en: Egypt's coastal sabkhas, vast salt flats that feel otherworldly, are not barren wastelands but 'living laboratories' recording climate change. Researchers studied four distinct sabkhas along the southern Red Sea coast, finding they hold crucial data about our changing climate.
summary.zh: 埃及沿海的盐沼（sabkhas）是广阔的盐碱地，感觉如同异星之地。它们并非贫瘠的荒漠，而是记录气候变化的“活的实验室”。研究人员研究了红海南部海岸的四个不同盐沼，发现它们蕴藏着关于我们不断变化的气候的关键数据。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Have you ever walked across a salt flat so expansive it feels like another planet? That's what it's like standing in Egypt's coastal sabkhas—those otherworldly landscapes where the ground crunches beneath your feet and the air shimmers with heat. These aren't just barren wastelands; they're living laboratories that record the pulse of our changing climate.

Our team spent years studying four distinct sabkhas along Egypt's southern Red Sea coast, and what we discovered surprised even us. These salt flats aren't static—they're growing, shifting and responding to forces both ancient and contemporary. The story they tell is one of resilience, adaptation and urgent warning. Our findings are published in Scientific Reports .

When I first set foot on the Ras Baghdadi sabkha, I was struck by its alien beauty. Here, the earth is literally tearing itself apart, not from human hands but from the raw power of geology and evaporation. The ground is carved by faults running in every direction, creating a natural plumbing system that draws seawater inland while mountain runoff flows down from the west. Where these waters meet and stagnate, they form something remarkable: an amoeba-shaped salt pond, its waters so saline that only the hardiest microbes survive.

We watched this pond evolve over decades using satellite imagery stretching back to 1973. What began as a crescent-shaped water body has transformed into something entirely different—a testament to how dynamic these systems truly are. The fault lines that control this sabkha aren't just academic curiosities; they're the architects of an ecosystem that supports everything from microbial mats to migratory birds.

Each sabkha we studied has its own personality. Marsa Abu Madd, for instance, is a lagoon-lover's paradise. Here, the sea and the salt flat dance a delicate tango, separated only by fragile sandbars that shift with each storm. When we dug pits into the sediment—carefully, because you never know when you might hit brine—we found alternating layers that read like a diary of the past: tidal deposits from wet phases, windblown sands from dry spells, each layer telling us when the sea advanced and when it retreated.

The Bir Shalatein-Marsa Himeira sabkha took our breath away. Standing there, we could see color zones stretching to the horizon like a natural artist's palette: white salt crusts, dark blue mud flats, pink and orange sands, and curious dark circles that turned out to be algal mats. It's like looking at a map of moisture itself—the white zones are where evaporation works hardest, the darker areas where life clings...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 您是否曾经走过广阔的盐滩，感觉就像另一个星球一样？这就是站在埃及沿海萨布哈的感觉——那些超凡脱俗的风景，大地在你脚下嘎吱作响，空气中闪烁着热气。这些不仅仅是贫瘠的荒地；它们是记录气候变化脉搏的活实验室。 我们的团队花了数年时间研究埃及红海南部海岸的四个不同的萨布哈，我们的发现甚至让我们感到惊讶。这些盐滩并不是静态的——它们在不断生长、变化，并对古代和当代的力量作出反应。他们讲述的故事是关于韧性、适应和紧急警告的故事。我们的研究结果发表在《科学报告》上。 当我第一次踏上Ras Baghdadi sabkha 时，我就被它奇异的美丽所震撼。在这里，地球实际上正在将自己撕裂，不是来自人类的双手，而是来自地质和蒸发的原始力量。地面由四面八方的断层雕刻而成，形成了一个天然的管道系统，将海水引入内陆，而山地径流则从西边流下。在这些水相遇并停滞的地方，它们形成了一些非凡的东西：一个阿米巴形的盐池，它的水盐分很高，只有最顽强的微生物才能生存。 我们利用自 1973 年以来的卫星图像观察了这个池塘几十年来的演变。一开始的新月形水体已经变成了完全不同的东西，这证明了这些系统的动态程度。控制这个 sabkha 的断层线不仅仅是学术好奇心;他们是生态系统的建筑师，支撑着从微生物垫到候鸟的一切事物。 我们研究的每个sabkha都有自己的个性。例如，马萨阿布马德 (Marsa Abu Madd) 就是泻湖爱好者的天堂。在这里，大海和盐滩跳起了精致的探戈，中间只隔着脆弱的沙洲，沙洲随着每次风暴而移动。当我们在沉积物中小心地挖坑时——因为你永远不知道什么时候可能会遇到盐水——我们发现了交替的层，读起来就像一本过去的日记：潮湿阶段的潮汐沉积物，干旱时期的风吹沙子，每一层都告诉我们海水何时前进和何时退却。 Bir Shalatein-Marsa Himeira sabkha 令我们惊叹不已。站在那里，我们可以看到色彩区域像自然艺术家的调色板一样延伸到地平线：白色的盐壳、深蓝色的泥滩、粉色和橙色的沙子，以及奇怪的黑眼圈，原来是藻垫。这就像看一张湿度地图——白色区域是蒸发最厉害的地方，较暗的区域是生命附着的地方……

reflection.en: Standing on Egypt's expansive salt flats, one can feel the immense scale of geological time and the subtle, persistent forces of climate. These sabkhas, far from being empty, are vibrant records of environmental change. They remind us that the Earth, in all its varied and wondrous forms, is a creation entrusted to our care, a testament to the Creator's...
reflection.zh: 站在埃及广阔的盐沼上，人们可以感受到地质时间的浩瀚与气候变化微妙而持久的力量。这些盐沼远非空无一物，而是环境变迁的生动记录。它们提醒我们，这片大地以其多样而奇妙的形式，是受托付于我们照管的造物，是造物主永恒力量与智慧的见证。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Saturn encounter may have set distant centaur on path to becoming a comet
title.zh: 土星的遭遇可能使遥远的半人马座走上成为彗星的道路

summary.en: More than 3 billion miles (4.8 billion kilometers) from Earth, an ancient icy object is slowly awakening. As it drifts inward through the solar system, the frozen body known as Centaur 450P/LONEOS has begun releasing gas and dust—behavior more commonly associated with comets than with centaurs, the small icy objects...
summary.zh: 在距离地球30多亿英里（48亿公里）之外，一个古老的冰冷天体正在慢慢苏醒。当它向太阳系内部漂移时，被称为半人马座450P/LONEOS的冰冻天体已经开始释放气体和尘埃——这种行为比通常被认为在木星和海王星之间运行的小型冰冷天体半人马座更常与彗星相关。由中佛罗里达大学行星科学家兼副教授查尔斯·尚博领导的研究人员表示，他们...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

More than 3 billion miles (4.8 billion kilometers) from Earth, an ancient icy object is slowly awakening. As it drifts inward through the solar system, the frozen body known as Centaur 450P/LONEOS has begun releasing gas and dust—behavior more commonly associated with comets than with centaurs, the small icy objects that typically orbit between Jupiter and Neptune.

Now, researchers led by UCF Planetary Scientist and Associate Professor Charles Schambeau say they may be witnessing the early stages of a centaur transforming into a comet.

Using observations from NASA's James Webb Space Telescope and the Gemini North telescope in Hawaii, scientists detected carbon dioxide gas, icy dust and signs of recent thermal activity surrounding 450P/LONEOS. The findings, published in the Planetary Science Journal , could provide new insight into how distant icy bodies evolve into active comets as they migrate inward through the solar system.

"Centaurs are scientifically important because they are thought to be transitional objects that originated farther out in the solar system and are slowly evolving toward becoming Jupiter-family comets. In that sense, they give us a way to study relatively primitive material from the outer solar system while it is beginning to respond to stronger solar heating."

Researchers believe 450P/LONEOS began "waking up" after a close gravitational encounter with Saturn in 1992 significantly altered its orbit.

The research team, which included UCF Planetary Sciences Group Research Scientist Maria Womack, Professor Yan Fernandez and graduate student Aren Beck, found that the interaction moved the object inward from a more distant trajectory, bringing its perihelion, the point in its orbit closest to the sun, closer to Jupiter.

As the centaur moved closer to the sun, researchers observed the gradual formation of a faint coma, a cloud of gas and dust surrounding the object commonly associated with cometary activity. Continued monitoring between 2019 and 2024 showed that the coma became increasingly visible as the object's distance from the sun decreased.

"That increased solar heating can warm the surface and subsurface layers of the nucleus," Schambeau says. "As those layers heat up, volatile ices or trapped gases can be released, which can drag dust away from the surface and produce a coma."

One of the study's most significant discoveries came from the James Webb Space Telescope, which detected carbon dioxide gas surrounding 450P/LONEOS at a distance where ordinary water ice would typically vaporize efficiently.

Researchers found strong evidence of...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 距地球超过 30 亿英里（48 亿公里）处，一个古老的冰体正在慢慢苏醒。当它向太阳系内漂移时，被称为 Centaur 450P/LONEOS 的冰冻天体开始释放气体和尘埃，这种行为更常见于彗星，而不是半人马座，半人马座是通常在木星和海王星之间运行的小型冰天体。 现在，由 UCF 行星科学家和副教授 Charles Schambeau 领导的研究人员表示，他们可能正在目睹半人马转变成彗星的早期阶段。 利用美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜和夏威夷双子座北望远镜的观测结果，科学家们检测到了二氧化碳气体、冰尘以及 450P/LONEOS 周围近期热活动的迹象。发表在《行星科学杂志》上的研究结果可以为遥远的冰体在向太阳系向内迁移时如何演化成活跃彗星提供新的见解。 “半人马星在科学上很重要，因为它们被认为是起源于太阳系更远的过渡天体，并且正在慢慢演化成为木星家族彗星。从这个意义上说，它们为我们提供了一种研究来自太阳系外相对原始物质的方法，同时它开始对更强的太阳加热做出反应。” 研究人员认为，450P/LONEOS 在 1992 年与土星的一次近距离引力相遇并显着改变了其轨道后开始“醒来”。 该研究小组包括中佛罗里达大学行星科学组研究科学家玛丽亚·沃马克（Maria Womack）、严·费尔南德斯（Yan Fernandez）教授和研究生阿伦·贝克（Aren Beck），他们发现，这种相互作用使物体从更远的轨道向内移动，使其近日点（其轨道上最接近太阳的点）更接近木星。 当半人马座靠近太阳时，研究人员观察到微弱的彗发逐渐形成，彗发周围是一团气体和尘埃云，通常与彗星活动有关。 2019 年至 2024 年间的持续监测表明，随着该天体与太阳距离的缩短，彗发变得越来越明显。 “太阳加热的增加可以使原子核的表面和地下层变暖，”尚博说。 “随着这些层的升温，挥发性的冰或滞留的气体会被释放出来，从而将灰尘从表面带走并产生昏迷。” 该研究最重要的发现之一来自詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜，该望远镜在普通水冰通常会有效蒸发的距离处检测到了 450P/LONEOS 周围的二氧化碳气体。 研究人员发现了强有力的证据...

reflection.en: The vastness of space and the intricate dance of celestial bodies offer endless opportunities for discovery. By observing objects like Centaur 450P/LONEOS, scientists can piece together cosmic history, revealing the dynamic forces that shape our solar system. This pursuit of knowledge through studying creation reflects a deep wonder at the Creator's...
reflection.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙和天体的精密运行提供了无穷无尽的探索机会。通过观察像半人马座450P/LONEOS这样的天体，科学家们可以拼凑出宇宙的历史，揭示塑造我们太阳系的动态力量。这种通过研究被造物来追求知识的努力，反映了对造物主工之奇妙的深深敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Canada's Labrador Shelf preserves climate records once thought erased by ice
title.zh: 加拿大拉布拉多陆架保存着曾被认为已被冰川抹去的が気候记录

summary.en: The Labrador Shelf, a shallow marine area off Canada's east coast, has been found to preserve crucial climate records from the last ice age. Scientists previously believed that the movement of the Laurentide Ice Sheet had eroded all older sedimentary deposits in the region, but new research indicates these records...
summary.zh: 位于加拿大东海岸的拉布拉多海的浅海区域——拉布拉多陆架，被发现保存着来自最后一个冰河时期的重要气候记录。科学家们此前认为，劳伦泰冰盖的移动已经侵蚀了该地区所有古老的沉积物，但新的研究表明，这些记录仍然完好无损，为了解过去的气候变化提供了见解。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The Labrador Shelf is a shallow marine area on the margin of the Labrador Sea in the North Atlantic off the east coast of Canada. During the last ice age, this region was covered by the Laurentide Ice Sheet, one of the largest ice masses in Earth's history, which once covered vast parts of North America.

Until now, scientists assumed that the final ice movements at the end of the Wisconsinan glaciation—the most recent North American glacial period about 22,000 years ago—had eroded the older sedimentary deposits on the shelf. A new study led by Kiel University (CAU), recently published in the Journal of Quaternary Science , revises this assumption.

Using high-resolution seismic data, the researchers identified eight distinct Quaternary sedimentary units. For the first time, they were also able to detect glaciomarine and interglacial sediments preserved between glacial deposits. This is direct evidence that not only the most recent glacial period, but also earlier glacial and interglacial periods, have been preserved on the Labrador Shelf.

"Our findings clearly show that deposits from earlier glacial and interglacial periods have been preserved within the sediments of the Labrador Shelf. Contrary to previous assumptions, the seafloor of the shelf is a remarkably well-preserved archive of climate and glacial history," explains lead author Dr. Kai-Frederik Lenz, who completed his doctoral research on this topic in the research group of Professor Dr. Sebastian Krastel at the Institute of Geosciences at Kiel University.

For the study, the scientists analyzed high-resolution 2D seismic reflection data collected during the MSM84 expedition aboard the German research vessel Maria S. Merian. These acoustic measurements reveal layer boundaries in the subsurface. The team investigated three large troughs crossing the shelf that had previously been considered completely scoured by the last ice advance.

The data allow the researchers to distinguish eight different Quaternary sediment units. The Quaternary is the most recent geological period, spanning approximately the last 2.6 million years and characterized by a constant alternation between glacial and interglacial periods. For the first time, the team also identified glaciomarine and open-marine deposits preserved between the glacial till layers.

The research team not only succeeded in mapping the stratigraphic sequences more precisely than ever before, but also identified different deposition and erosion processes. These observations were integrated into a 10-phase model describing the evolution of the Labrador Shelf from...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 拉布拉多大陆架是加拿大东海岸北大西洋拉布拉多海边缘的浅海区域。在上一个冰河时代，该地区被劳伦泰德冰盖覆盖，这是地球历史上最大的冰块之一，曾经覆盖了北美的大部分地区。 到目前为止，科学家们认为威斯康星州冰川期（大约 22,000 年前的最近的北美冰川期）末期的最终冰运动已经侵蚀了大陆架上较古老的沉积物。基尔大学 (CAU) 领导的一项新研究最近发表在《第四纪科学杂志》上，修正了这一假设。 研究人员利用高分辨率地震数据确定了八个不同的第四纪沉积单元。他们还第一次能够探测到冰川沉积物之间保存的冰川海洋和间冰期沉积物。这是拉布拉多陆架上不仅保存有最近的冰期，而且还保存有更早的冰期和间冰期的直接证据。 “我们的研究结果清楚地表明，拉布拉多陆架的沉积物中保存了早期冰期和间冰期的沉积物。与之前的假设相反，陆架的海底是保存非常完好的气候和冰川历史档案，”主要作者 Kai-Frederik Lenz 博士解释道，他在基尔大学地球科学研究所 Sebastian Krastel 教授的研究小组中完成了该主题的博士研究。 在这项研究中，科学家们分析了德国科考船 Maria S. Merian 号 MSM84 探险期间收集的高分辨率二维地震反射数据。这些声学测量揭示了地下的层边界。研究小组调查了横跨大陆架的三个大槽，此前这些槽被认为被最后一次冰的推进完全冲刷掉了。 这些数据使研究人员能够区分八种不同的第四纪沉积物单元。第四纪是最近的地质时期，跨越过去约 260 万年，其特点是冰期和间冰期之间不断交替。研究小组还首次发现了冰碛层之间保存的冰川海洋和开放海洋沉积物。 研究小组不仅成功地比以往更精确地绘制了地层序列，而且还确定了不同的沉积和侵蚀过程。这些观测结果被整合到一个 10 阶段模型中，描述了拉布拉多陆架从……的演变过程。

reflection.en: The ancient seabed of the Labrador Shelf, once buried under immense ice sheets, now reveals its secrets about Earth's climate history. This discovery reminds us that even in seemingly barren or erased landscapes, Yahweh's creation holds profound wisdom, waiting to be uncovered by patient observation and study. Through scientific inquiry, we can learn much...
reflection.zh: 拉布拉多陆架古老的洋底，曾被巨大的冰盖覆盖，如今却揭示了其关于地球气候历史的秘密。这一发现提醒我们，即使在看似贫瘠或被抹去的地貌中，雅伟的创造也蕴藏着深刻的智慧，等待着有耐心的观察和研究去发掘。通过科学探究，我们可以学到许多关于地球过去及其复杂系统的知识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: A roadmap for animal-free chemical testing
title.zh: 动物实验替代化学品测试路线图

summary.en: The European Commission has published a roadmap for the gradual phaseout of animal testing in the safety assessment of chemicals, aiming to implement the '3Rs principle' (replacement, reduction, and refinement). A central tool in this initiative is the ASPA (Alternative Safety Profiling Algorithm) workflow, designed...
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会发布了一项逐步淘汰化学品安全评估中动物试验的路线图，旨在实施“3R原则”（替代、减少和优化）。该计划的核心工具是ASPA（替代安全分析算法）工作流程，专为完全无动物、基于风险的安全评估而设计。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

For many years, the European Union has pursued a policy aimed at the replacement, reduction and refinement of animal testing (the 3Rs principle). To put the ethical principle of the 3Rs into practice, the European Commission has published a roadmap for the gradual phaseout of animal testing in the safety assessment of chemicals.

The ASPA (Alternative Safety Profiling Algorithm) workflow is a central, structured tool for fully animal-free, risk-based safety assessment. It is one of the most specific scientific concepts of modern Next Generation Risk Assessment (NGRA), a field in which new methods and software solutions have been developed to put the roadmap into practice.

The workflow was developed by the ASPIS cluster, a collaboration of the projects ONTOX, PrecisionTox and RISK-HUNT3R. Researchers at Fraunhofer ITEM have played a key role in developing the ASPA workflow within the RISK-HUNT3R project.

"The ASPA workflow is a transparent, reproducible and modular approach to animal-free Next Generation Risk Assessment of chemicals. It enables us to assess chemical risks using animal-free in silico and in vitro methods," says Sylvia Escher, a research scientist at Fraunhofer ITEM.

"With ASPA, we transparently integrate biological activity data from a range of new approach methodologies (NAMs), information on human uptake and exposure, and toxicological mechanisms. The aim is to enable scientifically sound safety assessments that can be readily used by regulatory authorities and to reproducibly assess the risks posed by chemicals on the basis of three main pillars: toxicokinetics (absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion), hazard and exposure."

NAMs are regarded as key technologies for the future safety assessment of chemicals. These include human-relevant cellular test systems, such as in vitro and ex vivo models, as well as computer-based models. Together, they form the foundation of NGRA. The ASPA workflow supports safety assessments. It comprises around 55 assessment elements, providing a multistage, modular strategy for risk analysis.

The aim of ASPA is to make safety assessments fully transparent for the recipient—such as a regulatory authority—by showing which steps and decisions led to the final outcome. ASPA requires precise justification of interim decisions, which in turn necessitates the continuous assessment of uncertainties. This complex process is supported by the ASPA-assist software, which guides users step by step through ASPA's 55 assessment modules and facilitates the reporting process in a reproducible and standardized...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 多年来，欧盟一直奉行旨在替代、减少和完善动物试验的政策（3R原则）。为了将3R道德原则付诸实践，欧盟委员会发布了化学品安全评估中逐步淘汰动物试验的路线图。 ASPA（替代安全分析算法）工作流程是一个中央结构化工具，用于完全无动物、基于风险的安全评估。它是现代下一代风险评估 (NGRA) 中最具体的科学概念之一，在该领域开发了新方法和软件解决方案以将路线图付诸实践。 该工作流程由 ASPIS 集群开发，该集群是 ONTOX、PrecisionTox 和 RISK-HUNT3R 项目的合作项目。 Fraunhofer ITEM 的研究人员在 RISK-HUNT3R 项目中开发 ASPA 工作流程方面发挥了关键作用。 “ASPA 工作流程是一种透明、可重复和模块化的方法，用于无动物的下一代化学品风险评估。它使我们能够使用无动物的计算机和体外方法来评估化学风险，”Fraunhofer ITEM 的研究科学家 Sylvia Escher 说道。 “通过 ASPA，我们透明地整合了来自一系列新方法 (NAM) 的生物活性数据、有关人体吸收和暴露的信息以及毒理学机制。目的是实现监管机构可以轻松使用的科学合理的安全评估，并根据毒代动力学（吸收、分布、代谢和排泄）、危害和暴露这三个主要支柱，可重复地评估化学品带来的风险。” NAM被视为未来化学品安全评估的关键技术。其中包括与人类相关的细胞测试系统，例如体外和离体模型，以及基于计算机的模型。它们共同构成了 NGRA 的基础。 ASPA 工作流程支持安全评估。它包含大约 55 个评估要素，为风险分析提供多阶段、模块化策略。 ASPA 的目标是通过显示哪些步骤和决策导致最终结果，使安全评估对接收者（例如监管机构）完全透明。 ASPA 需要对临时决策进行精确的论证，这反过来又需要对不确定性进行持续评估。这一复杂的过程由 ASPA 辅助软件支持，该软件引导用户逐步完成 ASPA 的 55 个评估模块，并以可重复和标准化的方式促进报告过程......

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge about the world around us, even in the realm of chemical safety, can be a path to understanding the intricate design of creation. As we develop new methods that respect life, we echo the ancient wisdom that creation itself holds lessons for us. May this scientific endeavor reflect a deeper reverence for the life Yahweh has made.
reflection.zh: 即使在化学品安全领域，对我们周围世界的知识的追求，也可以成为理解受造物精妙设计的途径。当我们开发尊重生命的新方法时，我们呼应了古老的智慧——受造物本身就蕴含着教导。愿这项科学事业能反映出对雅伟所造之生命的更深敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: A sustainable flame retardant derived from corn steep liquor
title.zh: 从玉米浆中提取可持续阻燃剂

summary.en: Researchers are developing a sustainable flame retardant by extracting phosphorus from corn steep liquor, a byproduct of starch production, to address the finite nature of current phosphorus resources, which are estimated to be depleted within 50 to 300 years.
summary.zh: 研究人员正在从玉米浆（淀粉生产的副产品）中提取磷，以开发一种可持续的阻燃剂，以应对当前磷资源有限的问题。据估计，磷资源将在 50 至 300 年内枯竭。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Certain phosphorus compounds are highly effective at suppressing fires, which is why they are widely used in flame retardants. Phosphorus, however, is a finite resource. Estimates suggest it could be depleted within the next 50–300 years. That is why, as part of the ScaleAmP project, a research team is working to extract phosphorus from corn steep liquor, a byproduct of starch production.

The team brings together researchers from the Fraunhofer Institute for Wood Research, Wilhelm-Klauditz-Institut WKI, and the Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Polymer Research IAP. Together with partners, they are using corn steep liquor to develop a flame retardant for use in wood-plastic composites (WPCs) and other biomaterials. Their work is published in the journal RSC Sustainability .

The phytic acid that can be extracted from corn steep liquor, also known as phytate, is a natural source of phosphorus. It is found in large quantities in plants such as corn, wheat bran, soybeans and rice.

"Commercial halogenated flame retardants are highly effective, but they are also toxic and environmentally harmful. To help protect the climate and meet regulatory requirements, industry is stepping up its transition to sustainable phosphorus-based flame retardants," says Matthias Bischoff, a research scientist at Fraunhofer WKI. "We are supporting this trend by using the phytic acid in corn steep liquor as an active ingredient in flame retardants and developing a cost-effective process for producing the flame retardant on a technical scale."

The research partners are demonstrating potential applications and flame retardant properties using a wood-plastic composite material, which is used in construction and in the automotive and furniture industries.

Thanks to its high phosphorus content, phytic acid has strong potential as a flame retardant, especially in the form of ammonium phytates. When heated, the molecule forms an insulating carbon layer that cuts off the fire's oxygen supply. However, for effective flame retardancy, phytic acid requires a source of nitrogen to form a synergistic compound with phosphorus. Pure phytic acid is ineffective and has a very low pH, making it incompatible with most materials.

One challenge the researchers faced was developing an efficient, cost-effective process to purify phytic acid, which is highly water-soluble. Using a series of simple procedural steps, Fraunhofer IAP researchers successfully extracted phytic acid. By separating solids from liquids and adjusting the pH, they separated proteins and organic acids, the main components of corn steep liquor....
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 某些磷化合物能够非常有效地抑制火灾，这就是它们被广泛用于阻燃剂的原因。然而，磷是一种有限的资源。据估计，它可能会在未来 50-300 年内耗尽。因此，作为 ScaleAmP 项目的一部分，一个研究团队正在致力于从玉米浆（淀粉生产的副产品）中提取磷。 该团队汇集了来自弗劳恩霍夫木材研究所、Wilhelm-Klauditz-Institut WKI 和弗劳恩霍夫应用聚合物研究所 IAP 的研究人员。他们与合作伙伴一起使用玉米浆开发一种用于木塑复合材料 (WPC) 和其他生物材料的阻燃剂。他们的工作发表在 RSC Sustainability 杂志上。 可从玉米浆中提取的植酸，也称为植酸盐，是磷的天然来源。它大量存在于玉米、麦麸、大豆和水稻等植物中。 “商业卤化阻燃剂非常有效，但它们也有毒且对环境有害。为了帮助保护气候并满足监管要求，工业界正在加紧向可持续的磷基阻燃剂过渡，”Fraunhofer WKI 的研究科学家 Matthias Bischoff 说道。 “我们通过使用玉米浆中的植酸作为阻燃剂的活性成分，并开发一种具有成本效益的技术规模生产阻燃剂的工艺来支持这一趋势。” 研究合作伙伴正在展示木塑复合材料的潜在应用和阻燃特性，该材料用于建筑、汽车和家具行业。 由于磷含量高，植酸具有作为阻燃剂的强大潜力，特别是以植酸铵的形式。加热时，分子形成绝缘碳层，切断火的氧气供应。然而，为了获得有效的阻燃性，植酸需要氮源来与磷形成协同化合物。纯植酸无效且 pH 值非常低，使其与大多数材料不相容。 研究人员面临的一个挑战是开发一种高效、经济的工艺来纯化高度水溶性的植酸。 Fraunhofer IAP 研究人员通过一系列简单的程序步骤成功提取了植酸。通过从液体中分离固体并调节pH值，他们分离了蛋白质和有机酸，这是玉米浆的主要成分......

reflection.en: The pursuit of sustainable solutions, like this research into flame retardants from corn steep liquor, reflects a thoughtful approach to resource management. Committing such endeavors to Yahweh, as Proverbs 16:3 suggests, seeks His blessing and guidance for the work of our hands, ensuring it serves a good purpose.
reflection.zh: 对可持续解决方案的追求，例如这项从玉米浆中提取阻燃剂的研究，体现了一种对资源管理的深思熟虑。正如箴言 16:3 所建议的，将此类事业托付给雅伟，是寻求祂对我们手所做之工的祝福和指引，确保它能服务于一个美好的目的。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Ocean heat waves linked with poorer health among children in coastal communities
title.zh: 海洋热浪与沿海社区儿童健康状况不佳有关

summary.en: Marine heat waves, characterized by abnormally warm ocean temperatures, are associated with increased risks of acute malnutrition and thinness in children residing in coastal communities within low- and middle-income countries, according to a study by researchers at Penn State and the University of North Carolina at...
summary.zh: 根据宾夕法尼亚州立大学和北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校研究人员的一项研究，海洋热浪——即异常温暖的海水温度时期——与低收入和中等收入国家沿海社区儿童急性营养不良和消瘦的风险增加有关。该研究结果发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Marine heat waves—periods of abnormally warm ocean temperatures—may have negative health effects on children who live in coastal communities in low- and middle-income countries, according to a study led by researchers at Penn State and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

The study—recently published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences —found that exposure to marine heat waves is associated with an increased risk of children experiencing acute malnutrition; thinness; chronic malnutrition, as indicated by low height for their age; and mortality.

Study co-author Brian Thiede, a professor of rural sociology, sociology and demography at Penn State's College of Agricultural Sciences and director of the university's Population Research Institute, said this may be because fish are an important source of protein and micronutrients among many coastal populations, and marine heat waves have the potential to hurt fish supplies through changes in fish populations' range, nutrient quality and mortality.

"Such disruptions can have direct impacts on food supplies and also may have secondary impacts by affecting income among fishers and food prices for consumers," he said. "These factors may shape households' ability to purchase food or to have the economic resources needed to access other critical services, such as health care."

Thiede added that the findings emphasize that climate change is affecting many Earth systems critical to human health and survival, including coastal communities that depend on the ocean for food or financial support.

"Researchers and practitioners should place renewed focus on coastal populations and better differentiate between the sources of vulnerability faced by coastal and inland populations," he said. "Coastal populations face unique climate-related risks due to their environment and livelihoods."

Marine heat waves are increasing in both frequency and severity as the global climate shifts, according to the researchers. These heat waves can trigger many additional ecological changes, including those that directly affect human society, with coastal populations in low- and middle-income countries being particularly vulnerable.

Thiede said attention to the human health impacts of these marine heat waves is important for several reasons, including the fact that, globally, human populations tend to be concentrated in and around coastal environments.

"Ocean temperatures are warming rapidly , making these heat waves more common and severe," he said. "Additionally, poor health has widespread and multidimensional...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 宾夕法尼亚州立大学和北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校的研究人员领导的一项研究表明，海洋热浪（海洋温度异常温暖的时期）可能会对生活在低收入和中等收入国家沿海社区的儿童产生负面健康影响。 这项研究最近发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上，发现接触海洋热浪会增加儿童患急性营养不良的风险。薄度；慢性营养不良，表现为身高低于同龄人；和死亡率。 该研究的合著者、宾夕法尼亚州立大学农业科学学院农村社会学、社会学和人口学教授、该大学人口研究所所长布莱恩·蒂德(Brian Thiede)表示，这可能是因为鱼类是许多沿海种群蛋白质和微量营养素的重要来源，而海洋热浪有可能通过鱼类种群范围、营养质量和死亡率的变化来损害鱼类供应。 他说：“这种干扰可能对粮食供应产生直接影响，也可能通过影响渔民的收入和消费者的粮食价格而产生二次影响。” “这些因素可能会影响家庭购买食品或拥有获得其他关键服务（例如医疗保健）所需的经济资源的能力。” 蒂德补充说，研究结果强调，气候变化正在影响许多对人类健康和生存至关重要的地球系统，包括依赖海洋提供食物或财政支持的沿海社区。 他说：“研究人员和从业人员应重新关注沿海人口，并更好地区分沿海和内陆人口面临的脆弱性来源。” “沿海人口由于其环境和生计而面临着独特的气候相关风险。” 研究人员表示，随着全球气候的变化，海洋热浪的频率和严重程度都在增加。这些热浪可能引发许多额外的生态变化，包括直接影响人类社会的生态变化，低收入和中等收入国家的沿海人口尤其脆弱。 蒂德说，出于多种原因，关注这些海洋热浪对人类健康的影响非常重要，其中包括全球人口往往集中在沿海环境及其周围的事实。 “海洋温度正在迅速变暖，使这些热浪变得更加普遍和严重，”他说。 “此外，健康状况不佳具有广泛且多方面的......

reflection.en: This study reveals a concerning link between environmental changes and the well-being of the most vulnerable. The children in these coastal communities, already facing economic challenges, are disproportionately affected by the warming oceans. We are called to be a voice for those whose health and future are threatened by forces beyond their control,...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了环境变化与最弱势群体福祉之间令人担忧的联系。这些沿海社区的儿童，本已面临经济挑战，却因海洋变暖而受到不成比例的影响。我们蒙召要为那些健康和未来受到无法控制的力量威胁的人发声，确保他们的需求不被忽视。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Watch: Astronauts set out on rare all-female spacewalk
title.zh: 观看：宇航员进行罕见的首次全女性太空行走

summary.en: For the sixth time in history, a team of two women completed a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.
summary.zh: 历史上第六次，一支由两名女性组成的团队完成了在国际空间站外的太空行走。

body.en:
For the sixth time in history, a team of two women completed a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.

Nasa astronaut Jessica Meir and French astronaut Sophie Adenot suited up for a 6.5-hour spacewalk. Meir rode the station’s Canadarm2 robotic arm to the worksites, while Adenot remained tethered to the station.

Meir previously made history in 2019 when she and Nasa astronaut Christina Koch completed the first ever all-female spacewalk.

This event marked the 284th spacewalk in support of space station assembly, maintenance and upgrades, and the seventh spacewalk of the year.
body.zh: 由两名女性组成的团队历史上第六次在国际空间站外完成了太空行走。 美国宇航局宇航员杰西卡·梅尔和法国宇航员索菲·阿德诺特准备好进行 6.5 小时的太空行走。梅尔乘坐空间站的 Canadaarm2 机械臂前往工作地点，而阿德诺则仍被拴在空间站上。 梅尔曾在 2019 年创造历史，当时她和美国宇航局宇航员克里斯蒂娜·科赫完成了有史以来第一次全女性太空行走。 此次活动是支持空间站组装、维护和升级的第284次太空行走，也是今年的第七次太空行走。

reflection.en: The recent spacewalk by astronauts Jessica Meir and Sophie Adenot marks a significant milestone, highlighting human capability and curiosity reaching beyond Earth. It prompts us to consider our place in the universe, as Psalm 8:4 asks, 'What is man that you are mindful of him?' This endeavor reminds us of the wonder of creation and the potential within...
reflection.zh: 宇航员杰西卡·梅尔和索菲·阿德诺最近进行的太空行走是一个重要的里程碑，它彰显了人类超越地球的能力和好奇心。这促使我们思考我们在宇宙中的位置，正如诗篇8:4所问：“人算什么，你竟顾念他？”这次努力提醒我们造物的奇妙以及被造物主形象所造的人类内在的潜力。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: 'We'll find way to save Jodrell Bank,' Burnham says
title.zh: 伯纳姆说：“我们将找到拯救乔德雷尔银行的方法”

summary.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has pledged to save the Jodrell Bank Observatory's Lovell telescope, a significant radio telescope in the UK, after it was deemed not a priority for future funding. Burnham expressed a strong commitment to preventing its closure, citing its cultural importance and personal memories of...
summary.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆承诺将拯救英国最大的望远镜所在地乔德雷尔银行天文台的洛厄尔望远镜。此前，该天文台未被列为未来资金优先事项。伯纳姆表示，他坚决反对其关闭，并提及其文化重要性以及他童年时参观该地的个人回忆。

body.en:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has vowed to save the UK's largest telescope at the Jodrell Bank Observatory.

The Lovell telescope, which has stood in Cheshire since 1957, is the world's third-largest steerable radio telescope.

But in July this year, UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) said the site would not be prioritised for further funding after its current agreement ended in March 2028.

Burnham said: "Every one of my generation went on a school trip to Jodrell Bank, and there is no way that we can see its demise, and it won't happen under my government."

UKRI said its decision for the site was "the result of a comprehensive, evidence-based prioritisation process".

The Prime Minister spoke of his determination to save the site after being asked a question about its future in the House of Commons.

Congleton MP Sarah Russell, whose constituency includes the Jodrell Bank site, said it "is facing a significant problem in the medium term because of funding cuts".

She called on Burnham and No 10 North to work alongside her and Macclesfield MP Tim Roca to address the issue.

Burnham said: "I know there are changes that have been made in relation to research funding, but Jodrell Bank is a heritage asset for the country, as well as a research asset."

He said he would set up the meeting she requested, adding: "There must be a way to save Jodrell Bank, and I give a commitment today, at this despatch box, we will find it."

The Jodrell Bank site was first established in 1945 and pioneered radio astronomy and the study of galaxies beyond our own.

The site has also been immortalised in popular science fiction productions from the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy to Doctor Who.

Scientists have described the UKRI's decision as "heartbreaking" and "scientifically misguided".

More than 150 public figures have signed a letter calling for the government to reverse its decision and "find funding immediately to save Jodrell Bank".

Signatories include astronaut Tim Peake, musicians Sir Brian May, Johnny Marr and Jarvis Cocker, the bands New Order, Elbow and Doves and comedian Dara Ó Briain.

Scotland's Astronomer Royal Prof Catherine Heymans, physicists Prof Jim Al-Khalili and Prof Brian Cox, and Judy Spence, the daughter of the site's founder Sir Bernard Lovell, have also signed it.

All scientific observations at Jodrell are expected to cease on the 1 April 2028 unless alternative funding can be found.

The Lovell Telescope has a diameter of 250ft (76.2m) and is part of the e-Merlin array, a network of telescopes up and down the country that is operated by the University of Manchester from the site.

Its work in tracking spacecraft in the early space race, and its research into quasars, pulsars and gravitational lenses, is also part of its outstanding...
body.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆发誓要拯救位于乔德雷尔班克天文台的英国最大望远镜。 洛弗尔望远镜自 1957 年以来一直矗立在柴郡，是世界第三大可操纵射电望远镜。 但今年 7 月，英国研究与创新 (UKRI) 表示，在当前协议于 2028 年 3 月结束后，该网站将不会优先获得进一步资助。 伯纳姆说：“我们这一代人都曾去乔德雷尔银行进行学校旅行，我们不可能看到它的消亡，而且在我的政府领导下，这种情况也不会发生。” UKRI 表示，该网站的决定是“全面、基于证据的优先顺序流程的结果”。 在下议院被问及有关该遗址未来的问题后，首相谈到了他拯救该遗址的决心。 康格尔顿议员莎拉·拉塞尔（其选区包括乔德雷尔银行网站）表示，“由于资金削减，该银行在中期面临着重大问题”。 她呼吁伯纳姆和北十号与她和麦克尔斯菲尔德议员蒂姆·罗卡一起解决这个问题。 伯纳姆说：“我知道研究经费方面已经发生了一些变化，但乔德雷尔银行是国家的遗产资产，也是研究资产。” 他说他会安排她要求的会面，并补充道：“一定有办法拯救乔德雷尔银行，我今天承诺，在这个快递箱里，我们会找到它。” Jodrell Bank 站点始建于 1945 年，开创了射电天文学和太阳系外星系的研究。 该网站还出现在《银河系漫游指南》和《神秘博士》等流行科幻小说中。 科学家们将 UKRI 的决定描述为“令人心碎”和“科学上的误导”。 超过 150 名公众人物签署了一封信，呼吁政府改变决定并“立即寻找资金来拯救 Jodrell 银行”。 签名者包括宇航员蒂姆·皮克、音乐家布莱恩·梅爵士、约翰尼·马尔和贾维斯·科克、New Order、Elbow 和 Doves 乐队以及喜剧演员达拉·奥·布莱恩。 苏格兰皇家天文学家凯瑟琳·海曼斯教授、物理学家吉姆·阿尔哈利利教授和布莱恩·考克斯教授以及该网站创始人伯纳德·洛弗尔爵士的女儿朱迪·斯彭斯也签署了该协议。 除非找到替代资金，否则 Jodrell 的所有科学观测预计将于 2028 年 4 月 1 日停止。 洛弗尔望远镜直径为 250 英尺（76.2 m），是 e-Merlin 阵列的一部分，e-Merlin 阵列是由曼彻斯特大学在该站点运营的遍布全国的望远镜网络。 它在早期太空竞赛中跟踪航天器的工作，以及对类星体、脉冲星和引力透镜的研究，也是其杰出成就的一部分……

reflection.en: The Lovell telescope at Jodrell Bank has stood since 1957, a testament to human curiosity and our drive to understand the cosmos. Prime Minister Burnham's commitment to preserving this instrument echoes the ancient wonder found in Psalm 19:1: "The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh; the skies proclaim the work of his hands." Even as we build tools to gaze...
reflection.zh: 乔德雷尔银行的洛厄尔望远镜自1957年以来一直矗立在那里，是人类好奇心和我们理解宇宙的驱动力的证明。首相伯纳姆致力于保护这一仪器，这呼应了诗篇19:1中古老的惊叹：“诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，穹苍传扬他手的作为。” 即使我们建造工具来凝视宇宙，我们也应被提醒那位在浩瀚天空中彰显其作品的创造者。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: How a small island in Canada appeared, vanished, and was found again
title.zh: 加拿大一座小岛的出现、消失和重现

summary.en: Officials in British Columbia have located a small, floating island that had previously disappeared from satellite tracking. The island, which appeared in a large freshwater lake, is about the size of one-and-a-half American football fields, but its origins remain unknown.
summary.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省的官员已找到一座此前在卫星追踪中消失的小型浮岛。这座出现在一处大型淡水湖中的岛屿，大小约相当于一个半美式足球场，但其起源仍然未知。

body.en:
A small, floating island on a lake in the Canadian province of British Columbia has been spotted again after officials lost track of it on satellite images following its initial discovery.

The forested island was first spotted in the middle of Williston Reservoir, BC's largest fresh water lake, in early August by boaters who captured the scene in a video that has since gone viral.

A satellite image from late July confirmed the existence of the island, which is the size of about one-and-a-half American football fields. But a few weeks later, it had vanished from that spot.

Officials in BC say they have now been able to locate it again near shore, though it's unclear where it came from.

Bob Gammer, a spokesperson for BC Hydro, a government-owned utility that maintains the reservoir and a nearby dam, first learned of the island's existence after seeing a video of it circulating on Canadian social media pages.

The video, taken by boaters, shows a forested patch of land that appeared to be bobbing in the water.

"I thought, well, this could be anywhere," he told the BBC. "Maybe it's not real."

But a satellite image pulled up by his team from 21 July confirmed it was real, and was indeed floating in the middle of the reservoir in a remote northern part of the province.

The island, however, appeared to have vanished in a satellite image taken just a few weeks later on 5 August. Its disappearance was covered by several international news outlets, sparking intrigue around the globe.

"We just don't know where it went," Gammer said. "Did it sink? Did it find its way into another corner of the reservoir?"

Gammer said he can now put the questions to bed. The island, he said, appears to have simply drifted towards shore and landed around 30 km (18.6 miles) from where it was first spotted.

This was confirmed by a new satellite image and a couple of eyewitness accounts from pilots flying above, he said.

BC Hydro estimates the island to be 9,800 square metres, or one hectare - roughly the size of one Canadian football field, or 1.5 American football fields.

As to its origins, Gammer said BC Hydro is still not entirely sure, but there is one strong theory: the island likely formed over many years from accumulating driftwood that served as a base for plants and trees to take root.

He added he believes it broke off from the reservoir's shoreline this summer as water levels rose to a high not seen since 2012.

One such island in Wisconsin's Lake Chippewa is known as the Forty Acre Bog. It is thought to be the result of peat bogs detaching from the bottom of the lake and floating to the surface.

Some years, local boaters will push the floating bog to prevent it from drifting towards a local bridge.

It houses diverse wildlife, according to the Lake Chippewa...
body.zh: 加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省一个湖上的一座小浮岛在最初发现后，官员们在卫星图像上失去了踪迹，但又再次被发现。 八月初，划船者首次在不列颠哥伦比亚省最大的淡水湖威利斯顿水库中央发现了这座森林岛屿，他们在一段视频中捕捉到了这一场景，该视频随后在网上疯传。 七月底的卫星图像证实了该岛的存在，该岛的大小约为一个半美式足球场。但几周后，它就从那个地方消失了。 不列颠哥伦比亚省官员表示，他们现在已经能够在海岸附近再次找到它，但尚不清楚它来自哪里。 BC Hydro 是一家政府所有的公用事业公司，负责维护水库和附近的一座水坝​​，其发言人鲍勃·加默 (Bob Gammer) 是在看到加拿大社交媒体页面上流传的一段视频后首次得知该岛的存在的。 这段由划船者拍摄的视频显示，一片森林覆盖的土地似乎在水中漂浮。 “我想，好吧，这可能在任何地方，”他告诉英国广播公司。 “也许这不是真的。” 但他的团队7月21日拍摄的卫星图像证实它是真实的，并且确实漂浮在该省北部偏远地区的水库中央。 然而，在几周后的 8 月 5 日拍摄的卫星图像中，该岛似乎已经消失。多家国际新闻媒体报道了它的失踪，引发了全球的关注。 “我们只是不知道它去了哪里，”加默说。 “它沉没了吗？它是否进入了水库的另一个角落？” 加默说他现在可以把问题搁置一边了。他说，该岛似乎只是漂向海岸，并在距首次发现地点约 30 公里（18.6 英里）处登陆。 他说，新的卫星图像和飞过上空的飞行员的几位目击者的叙述证实了这一点。 BC Hydro 估计该岛面积为 9,800 平方米，即一公顷，大约相当于一个加拿大足球场或 1.5 个美式足球场的大小。 至于它的起源，加默表示，BC Hydro 仍不完全确定，但有一个强有力的理论：该岛可能是多年来积累的浮木形成的，这些浮木是植物和树木扎根的基础。 他补充说，他相信今年夏天，随着水位升至 2012 年以来的最高水平，水库脱离了海岸线。 威斯康星州奇珀瓦湖中的一个这样的岛屿被称为“四十英亩沼泽”。它被认为是泥炭沼泽从湖底分离并浮到水面的结果。 有些年，当地的划船者会推动漂浮的沼泽，以防止其漂向当地的桥梁。 据奇珀瓦湖称，这里栖息着多种野生动物……

reflection.en: The appearance and disappearance of this floating island in British Columbia is a reminder of the profound mysteries within the natural world. Job 12:7-9 encourages us to ask the animals and birds, and to learn from the earth and sea, for creation itself speaks of its Creator's wisdom and power.
reflection.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省这座浮岛的出现与消失，提醒我们大自然中蕴含着深邃的奥秘。约伯记12:7-9鼓励我们去问 the animals and birds，并从大地和海洋中学习，因为创造本身就诉说着其创造者的智慧与大能。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Met Office: Summer 2026 was UK's hottest ever
title.zh: 英国气象局：2026年夏季是英国有记录以来最热的夏天

summary.en: The UK experienced a prolonged period of heat during spring and summer, with five widespread heatwaves and 40 days exceeding 30°C (86°F), significantly surpassing the previous record of 34 days.
summary.zh: 英国在春季和夏季经历了持续的高温天气，共有五次大范围热浪，气温超过30摄氏度（86华氏度）的天数达到40天，远远打破了此前34天的最高纪录。

reflection.en: The relentless heatwaves described in the UK's summer of 2026 serve as a stark reminder of the intricate and powerful systems within creation. Psalm 104:24 marvels at the diversity and wisdom evident in all of God's works, from the vastness of the seas to the smallest creatures. This record-breaking heat prompts reflection on our stewardship of the planet...
reflection.zh: 2026年英国创纪录的热浪天气，提醒我们造物中精妙而强大的系统。诗篇104:24赞叹雅伟一切作为的智慧与多样性，从辽阔的海洋到微小的生物。这破纪录的高温促使我们反思对地球的管理责任，以及其系统之间深刻的相互联系。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: More hosepipe bans in force as drought declared - is your area affected?
title.zh: 因干旱宣布更多限水令，你所在的地区受影响了吗？

summary.en: Approximately 30 million people are now subject to hosepipe bans due to increased water demand and insufficient rainfall. Both England and Wales experienced their driest July on record, with prolonged heatwaves straining water resources and impacting rivers, crops, and wildlife.
summary.zh: 由于用水需求增加和降雨不足，约有3000万人受到限水令的影响。英格兰和威尔士都经历了创纪录的最干旱的七月，持续的热浪使供水紧张，并影响了河流、农作物和野生动植物。

body.en:
Nearly three-quarters of England and all of Wales are under drought conditions, with repeated heatwaves leaving water supplies under strain.

Both England and Wales provisionally recorded their driest July on record. This lack of rainfall - on top of hot, dry weather in spring and early summer - has taken its toll on rivers, crops and nature.

Roughly 30 million people across parts of England and Wales are now covered by hosepipe bans.

There is no single definition of drought, but it is characterised by a period of low rainfall. As the ground dries out, crops and vegetation can begin to struggle.

If dry conditions persist, rivers, reservoirs and groundwater levels can also fall, putting pressure on water supplies.

Environmental bodies in each UK nation decide whether to declare drought or water scarcity by assessing current water resources alongside weather forecasts.

Both drought and water scarcity can lead to hosepipe bans, if they are not already in place.

While drought is driven by prolonged dry weather, water scarcity occurs when demand for water outstrips the available supply. This summer, restrictions have been introduced in some areas to help manage high demand.

But while recent months have seen temperatures regularly exceed 35C, winter was much wetter than usual.

It has raised questions about how effectively water resources are being managed, and whether the UK is prepared for the drier summers expected with climate change.

So far, 11 UK water companies have announced hosepipe bans. This means hosepipes cannot be used for watering gardens, washing vehicles and windows, and filling pools.

Ten companies are spread across central, southern and eastern parts of England, and one is in Wales.

In England, nearly three-quarters of the country is now in drought, according to the Environment Agency (EA). Northern parts of England are in "prolonged dry weather" - the category below drought.

Elsewhere, the whole of Wales is in drought, with Natural Resources Wales saying sustained high temperatures were causing the condition of the natural environment to "deteriorate".

While conditions have improved in some parts of Scotland following recent rainfall, some areas remain in the two most extreme categories of "moderate" or "significant" scarcity, according to the Scottish Environment Protection Agency.

Our three main sources of water are rivers, reservoirs and from deep underground.

Almost all river flows in England and Wales were classed as "below normal", "notably low" or "exceptionally low" in July, according to the UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology (UKCEH).

"This is the third time in the last five years that drought conditions have intensified rapidly following exceptional spring and summer dryness," said Steve Turner, a hydrologist at...
body.zh: 英格兰近四分之三的地区和威尔士全境都处于干旱状态，反复出现的热浪导致供水紧张。 英格兰和威尔士都暂时录得有记录以来最干燥的七月。除了春季和初夏炎热干燥的天气之外，降雨量的缺乏也对河流、农作物和自然造成了损害。 目前，英格兰和威尔士部分地区约有 3000 万人受到软管禁令的保护。 干旱没有单一的定义，但其特点是降雨量少的时期。当地面干燥时，农作物和植被就会开始生长。 如果干旱持续存在，河流、水库和地下水位也会下降，给供水带来压力。 英国每个国家的环境机构通过评估当前水资源和天气预报来决定是否宣布干旱或缺水。 如果尚未实施的话，干旱和缺水都可能导致软管禁令。 虽然干旱是由长期干旱天气造成的，但当水需求超过可用供应时，就会出现缺水。今年夏天，一些地区出台了限制措施，以帮助应对高需求。 不过，尽管最近几个月气温经常超过 35 摄氏度，但冬季却比平时潮湿得多。 它引发了人们对水资源管理效率的质疑，以及英国是否为气候变化带来的干燥夏季做好准备。 迄今为止，已有 11 家英国自来水公司宣布禁止使用软管。这意味着软管不能用于浇灌花园、清洗车辆和窗户以及给水池注水。 十家公司分布在英格兰中部、南部和东部地区，其中一家位于威尔士。 据环境署 (EA) 称，在英格兰，该国近四分之三的地区目前正处于干旱之中。英格兰北部地区正处于“长期干旱天气”——低于干旱的类别。 在其他地方，整个威尔士都处于干旱状态，威尔士自然资源部表示，持续的高温导致自然环境状况“恶化”。 苏格兰环境保护局表示，尽管近期降雨后苏格兰部分地区的情况有所改善，但一些地区仍处于“中度”或“严重”稀缺的两个最极端类别。 我们的三大水源是河流、水库和地下深处。 根据英国生态与水文中心 (UKCEH) 的数据，7 月份英格兰和威尔士几乎所有河流的流量都被列为“低于正常水平”、“显着低”或“异常低”。 “继春季和夏季异常干旱之后，这是过去五年来第三次干旱状况迅速加剧，”水文学家史蒂夫·特纳说。

reflection.en: The prolonged drought and heatwaves described in the report paint a stark picture of scarcity, impacting millions across England and Wales. In such times, Habakkuk 3:17-18 offers a profound perspective: even when the fields yield no harvest and the livestock perish, we can find our joy and strength in Yahweh. This ancient wisdom calls us to root our hope...
reflection.zh: 报道中描述的长期干旱和热浪描绘了一幅严峻的资源匮乏景象，影响着英格兰和威尔士的数百万人。在这样的时刻，《哈巴谷书》3:17-18 提供了深刻的视角：即使田地没有收成，牲畜也灭绝，我们仍能在雅伟里找到喜乐和力量。这古老的智慧呼唤我们将希望扎根于我们创造主的持久信实，而非世俗资源的丰盛。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: Could humans ever communicate with whales? - video
title.zh: 人类能否与鲸鱼交流？- 视频

summary.en: Since the first recording of whale song in 1949, researchers have been fascinated by their complex vocalizations. As technology advances, scientists are deciphering these intricate patterns to better understand and protect whales from human-caused harm.
summary.zh: 自1949年首次录制鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员一直被它们复杂的发声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译这些复杂的模式，以更好地理解并保护鲸鱼免受人类的伤害。

body.en: Ever since the earliest known recording of whale song was made in 1949 , researchers have been captivated by the wails, rumbles, clicks, grunts and squeals of their communication. As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. She explains how this knowledge could help us better protect whales from human-made harms. Credits: 1. Valeria Vergara/Raincoast Conservation Foundation 2. Footage courtesy of Raincoast Conservation Foundation - Obtained for research under SARA permit XMMS 4 2026 3. Video by Amanda Cotton/Project CETI 4. Footage courtesy of Valeria Vergara and GREMM. Obtained for research under SARA permits QUE-MM02-2016 and QUE-LEP-001-2018 5. Project CETI 6. Project CETI Continue reading...
body.zh: 自从 1949 年录制了已知最早的鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员就一直被它们交流时的哀号、隆隆声、咔哒声、咕噜声和尖叫声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译使不同物种的发声与众不同的复杂模式。马德琳·芬利听到艾玛·布莱斯的来信，她是一名记者，花了几个月的时间调查人类理解鲸鱼歌曲的努力。她解释了这些知识如何帮助我们更好地保护鲸鱼免受人为伤害。鸣谢： 1. Valeria Vergara/Raincoast 保护基金会 2. 影片由 Raincoast 保护基金会提供 - 根据 SARA 许可 XMMS 4 2026 获得用于研究 3. 视频由 Amanda Cotton/Project CETI 提供 4. 影片由 Valeria Vergara 和 GREMM 提供。根据 SARA 许可证 QUE-MM02-2016 和 QUE-LEP-001-2018 获得研究 5. CETI 项目 6. CETI 项目 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The deep sea holds mysteries, and the complex songs of whales are one of them. For decades, humans have listened, trying to understand. This pursuit of knowledge about creation mirrors the ancient truth that the heavens and earth declare the glory and wisdom of Yahweh, inviting us to observe and learn.
reflection.zh: 深海充满了奥秘，鲸鱼复杂的歌声便是其中之一。几十年来，人类一直在倾听，试图理解。这种对受造之物的求知欲，恰恰映照了古老的真理：诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，穹苍传扬祂的作为，邀请我们观察和学习。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Mindfulness may lower blood pressure in just 8 weeks
title.zh: 正念可能在短短8周内降低血压

summary.en: Mindfulness, gratitude, and optimism training may improve blood pressure, inflammation, and other heart-health measures within just eight to 12 weeks. The strongest programs paired daily practice with regular reinforcement, suggesting that improving psychological well-being can lead to better physical health outcomes.
summary.zh: 正念、感恩和乐观训练可以在短短八到十二周内改善血压、炎症和其他心脏健康指标。最有效的项目将日常练习与定期强化相结合，表明改善心理健康可以带来更好的身体健康结果。

body.en:
Simple practices such as mindfulness, gratitude journaling, and optimism training may improve several markers of cardiovascular health within a matter of weeks. A recent study found that these positive psychology interventions were consistently associated with improvements in blood pressure, inflammation, and other heart disease risk factors. Because some of the benefits appeared to be connected with healthier behaviors, including better eating habits and increased physical activity, the researchers said continued reinforcement may be necessary to maintain progress over time.

Rosalba (Rose) Hernandez, a professor of social work at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, led the research team. The group reviewed results from 18 randomized controlled trials that tested positive psychology and mindfulness interventions designed to improve mental or physical health.

The programs varied widely in how they were delivered. Some relied on structured phone sessions, journaling paired with brief check-ins, or digital tools such as apps and text messages. Others involved interactive in-person group meetings or hybrid approaches that combined face-to-face activities with online tools and virtual sessions.

Most programs included weekly sessions along with activities participants completed at home to reinforce what they had learned. The majority lasted between six and 12 weeks.

The studies generally enrolled groups of 50-200 adults who already had elevated cardiovascular risk, including uncontrolled hypertension, heart failure, or other health conditions. Participants were usually in their late 50s to mid-60s. Among studies that reported gender, women made up 35-55% of the participants.

"In hypertension and postacute coronary syndrome cohorts, mindfulness-based programs delivered over an eight-week period reduced systolic blood pressure and lowered inflammatory markers such as high-sensitivity C-reactive protein and fibrinogen," said Hernandez, who is a Fellow of the American Heart Association. "A 12-week spirituality-based digital intervention achieved one of the largest reductions -- reducing systolic blood pressure measured with a standard cuff by 7.6 points, and central systolic pressure -- which is measured in the aorta as it leaves the heart -- by 4.1 points."

Previous research on positive psychology often did not clearly establish how frequently people needed to practice these techniques, or for how long, to gain health benefits, Hernandez said. Her team wanted to determine what level of participation was most consistently associated with improvements in cardiovascular health.

The review showed that programs with more frequent participant contact tended to produce the most reliable physiological benefits. Hernandez said this finding highlights...
body.zh: 正念、感恩日记和乐观训练等简单的练习可以在几周内改善心血管健康的多项指标。最近的一项研究发现，这些积极的心理干预措施始终与血压、炎症和其他心脏病危险因素的改善相关。由于一些好处似乎与更健康的行为有关，包括更好的饮食习惯和增加体力活动，研究人员表示，随着时间的推移，可能需要持续强化才能保持进展。 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校社会工作教授罗萨尔巴·埃尔南德斯（Rosalba Hernandez）领导了该研究小组。该小组审查了 18 项随机对照试验的结果，这些试验测试了旨在改善心理或身体健康的积极心理学和正念干预措施。 这些项目的交付方式差异很大。有些人依赖结构化电话会议、日记和简短的签到，或者应用程序和短信等数字工具。其他活动则涉及交互式面对面小组会议或将面对面活动与在线工具和虚拟会议相结合的混合方法。 大多数项目包括每周一次的课程以及参与者在家完成的活动，以巩固他们所学到的知识。大多数持续 6 到 12 周。 这些研究通常招募了 50-200 名患有心血管疾病风险较高的成年人，包括未受控制的高血压、心力衰竭或其他健康状况。参与者通常在 50 多岁到 60 多岁之间。在报告性别的研究中，女性占参与者的 35-55%。 美国心脏协会会员埃尔南德斯说：“在高血压和急性冠脉综合征队列中，为期八周的基于正念的计划降低了收缩压，并降低了高敏 C 反应蛋白和纤维蛋白原等炎症标志物。” “为期 12 周的基于灵性的数字干预实现了最大程度的降低之一——使用标准袖带测量的收缩压降低了 7.6 点，中心收缩压（在主动脉离开心脏时测量的）降低了 4.1 点。” 埃尔南德斯说，之前关于积极心理学的研究通常没有明确确定人们需要多长时间练习这些技巧，或者练习多长时间才能获得健康益处。她的团队希望确定什么程度的参与与心血管健康的改善最相关。 审查表明，参与者接触越频繁的项目往往会产生最可靠的生理益处。埃尔南德斯说，这一发现凸显了......

reflection.en: This study offers a hopeful perspective on the mind-body connection, suggesting that cultivating inner peace through practices like mindfulness can have tangible benefits for our physical health. It echoes the ancient wisdom that a healthy spirit contributes to a healthy body, reminding us that tending to our emotional and mental well-being is a vital part...
reflection.zh: 这项研究为身心联系提供了一个充满希望的视角，表明通过正念等练习培养内心的平静可以对我们的身体健康产生切实的益处。它呼应了古老的智慧，即健康的灵有助于健康的体魄，提醒我们照顾好自己的情感和心理健康是整体护理的重要组成部分。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Scientists discover why snake embryos twist into spirals
title.zh: 科学家发现蛇胚胎为何卷成螺旋形

summary.en: An international research team has discovered a likely reason why snake embryos curl into tight right-handed spirals before hatching. The coiling appears to be a mechanism to accommodate their exceptionally long bodies, as the rapid lengthening of the embryo's body outpaces its gut, creating a tether that forces it to...
summary.zh: 一个国际研究小组发现了一个可能的解释，说明为什么蛇胚胎在孵化前会卷成紧密的右旋螺旋形。这种卷曲似乎是为了适应它们异常长的身体，因为胚胎身体的快速增长超过了其肠道的增长速度，形成了一个束缚，迫使其弯曲和扭曲。

body.en:
An international research team led by scientists in Canada has uncovered a likely explanation for one of the more unusual features of snake development: why embryos curl into tight spirals before hatching. This coiling behavior appears to help snakes accommodate the exceptionally long bodies that distinguish them from every other vertebrate.

The findings, published in Current Biology , suggest that the spiral forms as the embryo's body rapidly lengthens while its gut acts as a tether. That physical constraint causes the growing body to buckle and twist into a right-handed coil.

"It's like when you adjust the length of a strap and the longer, buckling side of the loop twists," explains senior author and team leader Dr. Tetsuto Miyashita, evolutionary biologist at the Canadian Museum of Nature.

The discovery adds snake embryos to a long list of naturally occurring spiral structures that scientists are still working to understand.

"There is a touch of mystery to spirals, and we are only beginning to understand how these shapes are produced in animals, such as our looping intestine, snail shells, and now these beautifully coiled snake embryos," says lead author Alexandra Weber, now a graduate student in zoology at the University of British Columbia.

Adds Miyashita: "These puzzles beckon our curiosity. After all, spiral forms in nature have inspired human creations ranging from rotini pasta, to a barber's pole or even portrayals of the biblical 'Tower of Babel'."

The project itself grew out of an unusual circumstance. During the COVID lockdown in 2020, Miyashita was working from home and looking for a research question his students could investigate without access to laboratories or museum collections.

"Then the lightbulb turned on. I had inherited from my PhD advisor this fascination with asymmetries in animal forms. So every time I saw images of snake embryos in papers, I wondered whether they are right- or left-handed in their coiling."

Miyashita asked Weber, who was then at Carleton University, along with two undergraduate students at the University of Ottawa, to search published research and museum databases for photographs of developing snakes.

"We obtained pictures for more than 900 embryos from 39 snake and other limbless squamate species. That's a statistically robust sample."

A clear pattern emerged. During the first several weeks after the eggs were laid, the embryos appeared to coil only dextrally, meaning to the right, as viewed from head to tail.

"At these stages, the embryos don't have muscles to move with, so different forces are making them coil right-handed," Weber explains. "But we didn't know what's making them do that."

Because the embryos were not yet capable of actively moving their bodies into position, the researchers...
body.zh: 由加拿大科学家领导的一个国际研究小组发现了蛇发育的一个更不寻常的特征的可能解释：为什么胚胎在孵化前卷曲成紧密的螺旋。这种盘绕行为似乎有助于蛇适应超长的身体，这使蛇与其他脊椎动物区别开来。 发表在《当代生物学》上的研究结果表明，螺旋是随着胚胎的身体迅速拉长而形成的，而其肠道则充当了系绳的作用。这种身体限制导致生长中的身体弯曲并扭曲成右手线圈。 “这就像当你调整带子的长度和环扭曲的较长、弯曲的一侧时，”加拿大自然博物馆的进化生物学家、资深作者和团队负责人 Tetsuto Miyashita 博士解释道。 这一发现将蛇胚胎添加到一长串自然存在的螺旋结构中，科学家们仍在努力了解这些结构。 “螺旋有一丝神秘感，我们才刚刚开始了解这些形状是如何在动物身上产生的，比如我们的环形肠道、蜗牛壳，以及现在这些美丽的盘绕蛇胚胎，”主要作者、不列颠哥伦比亚大学动物学研究生亚历山德拉·韦伯说。 宫下补充道：“这些谜题唤起了我们的好奇心。毕竟，自然界中的螺旋形状激发了人类的创作灵感，从罗蒂尼面食到理发店的柱子，甚至是圣经中‘巴别塔’的描绘。” 该项目本身是在一个不寻常的情况下产生的。在 2020 年新冠疫情封锁期间，宫下在家工作，寻找学生可以在不进入实验室或博物馆藏品的情况下进行研究的研究问题。 “然后灯泡亮了。我从我的博士导师那里继承了对动物形态不对称的迷恋。所以每次我在论文中看到蛇胚胎的图像时，我都想知道它们在盘绕时是右手还是左手。” 宫下要求当时就读于卡尔顿大学的韦伯以及渥太华大学的两名本科生在已发表的研究和博物馆数据库中搜索蛇发育过程中的照片。 “我们获得了 39 种蛇和其他无肢有鳞动物的 900 多个胚胎的照片。这是一个统计上可靠的样本。” 一个清晰的模式出现了。在产卵后的最初几周内，胚胎似乎仅向右卷曲，即从头到尾观察时向右卷曲。 韦伯解释说：“在这些阶段，胚胎没有肌肉可以移动，因此不同的力量使它们以右手方式卷曲。” “但我们不知道是什么让他们这样做。” 由于胚胎尚不能主动将其身体移动到位，研究人员...

reflection.en: The intricate design of a snake embryo, twisting into a spiral to accommodate its growing body, is a testament to the wisdom embedded in creation. As Job reminds us, observing the natural world can teach us profound truths about the Creator's ingenuity and purpose. May we approach scientific discovery with humility, recognizing that each new insight into...
reflection.zh: 蛇胚胎为适应其生长身体而扭曲成螺旋形的复杂设计，证明了造物中蕴含的智慧。正如约伯所提醒我们的，观察自然界可以教会我们关于创造者创造力和目的的深刻真理。 愿我们以谦卑的态度进行科学探索，认识到生命机制的每一个新发现都揭示了雅伟那精湛的杰作。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Reaching 90 without dementia doesn’t mean you’re in the clear
title.zh: 活到90岁不得失智，并不意味着你已安然无恙

summary.en: A study of individuals over 90 revealed that dementia risk is significantly influenced by sex, race, and genetics, with women and Black participants facing higher risks. However, some individuals remained cognitively healthy despite carrying major risk factors, suggesting potential protective mechanisms.
summary.zh: 一项针对90岁以上人群的研究发现，失智症的风险仍然受到性别、种族和遗传的强烈影响，女性和黑人参与者的风险尤其高。然而，一些人在携带主要风险因素的情况下仍然保持认知健康，这可能提供了……

body.en:
People who reach their 90s without dementia might appear to have escaped much of the danger of cognitive decline. Until recently, however, scientists had relatively little evidence showing what happens to dementia risk at such advanced ages.

That gap is becoming increasingly important as lifespans rise around the world. By 2100, roughly 230 million people 90 or older could be alive worldwide, increasing the need for better information about how the brain ages in this rapidly growing population.

Researchers at UC Davis Health and Kaiser Permanente are helping address that question through the LifeAfter90 study , which has followed a large group of adults in their 90s since 2018. The latest findings, published in The Lancet Healthy Longevity , show notable differences in dementia risk by sex, race, ethnicity, and genetics.

"We know from other studies, done in people 65 and older, that there are differences in dementia rates, and women tend to have higher risk, but nobody knew if that was true after 90," said Rachel Whitmer, UC Davis Health professor of public health sciences and neurology, chief of epidemiology and senior author on the study. "We need to understand who is most affected by dementia after 90 and how the main Alzheimer's risk gene (APOE) factors in."

Participants in LifeAfter90 are Kaiser Permanente members who were at least 90 years old and showed no signs of dementia when they enrolled. Under Whitmer's leadership, researchers evaluate participants every six months to monitor changes in cognitive health.

Their long history with Kaiser Permanente gives researchers access to an unusually extensive collection of medical information. For some participants, health records extend back to the 1960s. The new analysis included records from more than 800 people with a median age of 92 and represents the first study of dementia after 90 conducted in a highly diverse cohort.

The results showed that many dementia disparities seen earlier in life continue into very old age. Women age 90 and older had about twice the dementia risk of men. Researchers also identified differences among racial and ethnic groups, with black participants facing a 75% higher risk than Asian participants.

"It is striking that the racial and ethnic disparities in dementia risk observed in younger adults continue into the tenth decade of life," said Hilary Colbeth, a UC Davis postdoctoral scholar in public health sciences and first author on the paper. "Specifically, black and Hispanic participants had significantly higher dementia incidence rates than white and Asian participants."

Researchers also examined the role of APOE, a gene strongly associated with Alzheimer's disease. Different versions of the gene can influence risk in opposite directions. APOE2 is...
body.zh: 90多岁时没有患痴呆症的人似乎已经摆脱了认知能力下降的大部分危险。然而，直到最近，科学家们还没有多少证据表明如此高龄的痴呆风险会发生什么变化。 随着世界各地寿命的延长，这种差距变得越来越重要。到 2100 年，全世界大约有 2.3 亿 90 岁或以上的人还活着，因此越来越需要更好地了解这个快速增长的人口中大脑如何老化的信息。 加州大学戴维斯分校健康中心和凯撒医疗机构的研究人员正在通过 LifeAfter90 研究帮助解决这个问题，该研究自 2018 年以来对一大批 90 多岁的成年人进行了跟踪。发表在《柳叶刀健康长寿》上的最新研究结果显示，不同性别、种族、民族和基因的痴呆风险存在显着差异。 “我们从其他针对 65 岁及以上人群进行的研究中得知，痴呆症发病率存在差异，女性往往有更高的风险，但没有人知道 90 岁以后是否属实，”加州大学戴维斯分校健康中心公共卫生科学和神经病学教授、流行病学负责人、该研究的资深作者雷切尔·惠特默 (Rachel Whitmer) 说。 “我们需要了解 90 岁以后哪些人最容易患痴呆症，以及主要的阿尔茨海默病风险基因 (APOE) 是如何影响的。” LifeAfter90 的参与者是 Kaiser Permanente 会员，他们年龄至少 90 岁，并且在加入时没有表现出痴呆迹象。在惠特默的领导下，研究人员每六个月对参与者进行一次评估，以监测认知健康的变化。 他们与 Kaiser Permanente 的悠久历史使研究人员能够获得异常广泛的医疗信息。对于一些参与者来说，健康记录可以追溯到 20 世纪 60 年代。新的分析包括 800 多名平均年龄为 92 岁的人的记录，这是第一个在高度多样化的队列中进行的 90 岁以后痴呆症研究。 结果显示，许多早年出现的痴呆症差异一直持续到老年。 90 岁及以上的女性患痴呆症的风险大约是男性的两倍。研究人员还发现了种族和民族之间的差异，黑人参与者面临的风险比亚洲参与者高 75%。 加州大学戴维斯分校公共卫生科学博士后学者、该论文的第一作者希拉里·科尔贝斯 (Hilary Colbeth) 表示：“令人惊讶的是，在年轻人中观察到的痴呆风险的种族和民族差异一直持续到十多岁。” “具体来说，黑人和西班牙裔参与者的痴呆症发病率明显高于白人和亚洲人参与者。” 研究人员还研究了 APOE 的作用，APOE 是一种与阿尔茨海默病密切相关的基因。该基因的不同版本可以以相反的方向影响风险。 APOE2 是...

reflection.en: As lifespans increase, the challenges of aging, particularly cognitive decline, become more pronounced. This study, following individuals in their 90s, underscores that even at advanced ages, factors like sex and race continue to shape health outcomes, reminding us of the Psalmist's plea: 'Do not cast me off in the time of old age; do not forsake me when my...
reflection.zh: 随着寿命的延长，衰老带来的挑战，尤其是认知能力下降，变得日益严峻。这项对90多岁人群的研究强调，即使在晚年，性别和种族等因素仍然影响着健康状况，这让我们想起诗篇作者的祈求：“年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我；我的力衰的时候，求你不要留下我。”...
